data.description:
## Incident Overview
Live e2e_field_validation_probe run 2026-06-06: Phase 8 jira-deletes succeeded, but all 14 delete-local-* steps FAILED. Each failure was preceded by 'U .bridge_state/prev_snapshot.json' — the ticket-tracker was left with an unresolved 'UU .bridge_state/prev_snapshot.json' merge conflict (44 unpushed local commits + staged tombstones), wedging the ticket CLI. The run's local tickets were left orphaned (manually cleaned this session: 14 tickets, tag field-probe-1780715212).

## Pre-existing pollution
33 FIELD-PROBE orphan tickets from PRIOR runs remain in the backlog (timestamps 1780533755 / 1780556524 / 1780534625). Some are inbound-materialized (jira-dig-5281..5289) and may be Jira-bound — mass-deletion risks mirroring deletes to live Jira, so they need careful handling.

## Root cause
The probe runs reconciler passes (writing prev_snapshot.json to the tickets orphan branch) and Phase 8's local-delete invokes the ticket CLI, whose origin/tickets sync collides on prev_snapshot.json. PROBE_EXIT=1 even though the sync/test work succeeded.

## Fix direction
Make Phase 8 local-delete resilient to tracker-sync conflicts (reset/ignore prev_snapshot.json before delete, or delete via tombstone without a conflicting fetch/merge), ensure the trap-less Phase 8 still runs to completion, and add a guarded sweep for the 33 pre-existing orphans. Discovered during dcf3 live investigation.
data.title: [e2e_field_validation_probe.sh/Phase-8]: local-ticket delete fails on prev_snapshot.json merge conflict -> FIELD-PROBE tickets orphaned (33 from prior runs)
